name: thimble
description: thimble for Claude Code: select words in a reply and press c to cite them (a second Claude finds and checks their source), or set Citations to have Claude cite each claim you would check; a click on a citation opens its evidence. Claude draws interactive cards of the data, and v visualizes the last answer as a card. ] and [ step through a reply's citations, explainers and cards in a tray above the prompt; s rewrites a reply shorter or longer, more novice or more expert, and b catches up on several; after each reply an observer explains terms you may not know and points out important details; c lists the session's evidence; t lists the side threads asked about a citation, card or pane. Labels sort records into values, and coverage says what Claude read. Minimal makes everything on demand.

minimal.title: Minimal
minimal.description: Everything on demand: nothing runs after a reply and nothing is marked by itself. Select words and press e to explain them or c to cite them, h gives heads-ups on the last answer, and f in Evidence finds the claims. Claude still draws cards, and v visualizes the last answer. The settings below come back when it is off.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: auto cite + verify: Claude cites each claim you would check, and a second Claude verifies each citation after each reply. auto cite: Claude cites, and a citation is checked when you open it, which spends fewer tokens. manual: select words in an answer and press c to cite them. off: no citations.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Claude draws interactive cards, and v visualizes the last answer as a card.

squeezeAnswers.title: Rewrite
squeezeAnswers.description: s rewrites an answer shorter or longer, for a reader more novice or more expert, or in your own words. One rewrite each time you ask.

catchUp.title: Catch-up
catchUp.description: After replies to background work pile up, b sums them up in one short note, and 0 shows the replies again. One rewrite each time you ask.

explain.title: Explainers
explain.description: Marks the terms you may not know; ] opens what each one means here. A small part of the call after each reply.

details.title: Heads-ups
details.description: Marks a detail of an answer that is easy to miss and changes what it means; ] opens its heads-up. A small part of the call after each reply.

claimsMode.title: Evidence
claimsMode.description: c opens what Claude and you claimed in the session, with why each holds and its sources. auto: the claims are extracted after each reply, the largest part of the call after it. on demand: f in the Evidence pane extracts them, which spends fewer tokens. off: no Evidence pane.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The bar counts the labels Claude made, and l opens them. No model call.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: The bar shows how much of the data Claude has read, and r opens it by folder. No model call: thimble counts the files after each turn.

squeezeCards.description: Removed: a squeeze may move or leave out a card.
